trials.claim: All future Starter and Builder plan updates included
trials.claimQuote: All future Starter (Tier 1), Builder (Tiers 2-5) plan updates
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only show standard termination and loss-of-access terms; they do not address whether future Starter or Builder updates are included, and no exhibit confirms that promise.

exhibits.quote: We may suspend/terminate access at any time for violations or other reasons.
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to cut off access entirely, which voids any promise of lifetime future updates.

exhibits.quote: Upon termination, you lose access to saved projects (unless exported).
exhibits.argument: Lifetime updates are meaningless if termination removes access to saved projects unless already exported.

trials.claim: Build, iterate and ship Manifest V3 Chrome extensions from a plain-English prompt
trials.claimQuote: Build, iterate, and ship Manifest V3 Chrome extensions from a plain-English prompt
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes generating a full Manifest V3 package from plain English, and a non-programmer buyer confirms building extensions that way. The approval disclaimer and many iterations do not contradict building and iterating from a prompt.

exhibits.quote: We do not guarantee Chrome approval or functionality.
exhibits.argument: The vendor disclaims any guarantee that extensions will work or ship to the store.

exhibits.quote: Reaching the current working version took 84 iterations.
exhibits.argument: Building and iterating from a prompt required 84 iterations, not a simple prompt-to-ship flow.

exhibits.quote: Describe what you want in plain English and PlugThis generates the full Manifest v3 package: a manifest.json with the right permissions, content scripts scoped to the right URLs, a popup interface, a background service worker, and a Supabase backend when the extension needs one.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states plain-English description generates full Manifest V3 package with manifest, scripts, popup and worker.

exhibits.quote: I’m not a programmer, so I never imagined I could build my own Chrome extensions. But with PlugThis.ai, I was able to explain what I wanted in plain language and actually get it done.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms building Chrome extensions from plain-language description works as promised.

trials.claim: Turn a plain-English prompt into a complete production-ready Manifest V3 Chrome extension in minutes
trials.claimQuote: Turn a plain-English prompt into a complete, production-ready Manifest V3 Chrome extension in minutes
trials.reasoning: The vendor warns outputs may be incomplete or erroneous, and a buyer needed 20 iterations over a full day to make an extension work. That materially conflicts with a complete, production-ready extension in minutes.

exhibits.quote: Outputs may be incomplete or erroneous; use at your own risk.
exhibits.argument: The vendor warns outputs may be incomplete or erroneous, contradicting production-ready in minutes.

exhibits.quote: It took me 20 iterations but in just one day I was able to make it work.
exhibits.argument: A complex extension took 20 iterations and a full day, not minutes from a single prompt.

exhibits.quote: A complete extension: popup, scripts, backend, everything. Not a wireframe. Not a prototype. A working extension.
exhibits.argument: Vendor promises output is a complete working extension, not a prototype.

exhibits.quote: I tried two extensions in half an hour.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms building complete extensions in minutes-scale time.

trials.claim: Generates full Manifest V3 source code with manifest, content scripts, background service worker and popup UI
trials.claimQuote: Generate full Manifest V3 source code with manifest, content scripts, background service worker, and popup UI, automatically
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists generation of the manifest, content scripts, popup, and background service worker, and a buyer confirms receiving a complete package with those parts. Warnings about possible errors or refinement do not contradict that those components are generated.

exhibits.quote: Important: Outputs may contain errors, inaccuracies, or third-party IP.
exhibits.argument: The vendor admits generated code may contain errors, undermining automatic full correct generation.

exhibits.quote: It took me a few hours to get everything right, and I used ChatGPT to refine it, but the results have been amazing!
exhibits.argument: Full working code required hours and external ChatGPT refinement, not automatic generation.

exhibits.quote: Describe what you want in plain English and PlugThis generates the full Manifest v3 package: a manifest.json with the right permissions, content scripts scoped to the right URLs, a popup interface, a background service worker, and a Supabase backend when the extension needs one.
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists automatic generation of manifest, content scripts, popup UI and background worker.

exhibits.quote: PlugThis produces a complete extension package: project structure, manifest, scripts, interface, and design.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms product outputs complete package including manifest, scripts and interface.
